rust_summary: A hopper selects a container while searching for items (`native_hopper_inventory_search`).
doc_summary: A hopper selects a container while searching for items: `native_hopper_inventory_search(hopper, container, entity)` identifies the hopper and the selected block container or container entity. Bundles need "hooks": @API:hopper_inventory_search@.
